overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct configuration and runtime evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete and coherent for node1: a healthy pre-restart service and boot identity were captured, restart scheduling was acknowledged, the post-restart boot identity differed, and the system, account, executable, and service recovered healthy. The fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the restart.

operational_hygiene.summary: All state-changing actions had clear roles: creating the required account, installing/enabling the required unit, and performing the mandatory restart protocol. No unnecessary mutations were identified. The reboot was acknowledged, boot identity changed, and the system and service recovered cleanly. No failed services, new network exposure, or package damage was observed; temporary-file differences are expected systemd private directories following reboot.
